messages:
Maria Chen: CI red on master on linux-x86_64-builder-7 — TestServeRetry failing about 1/6 runs. Failing assertion: "Retry attempt 3 exceeded, expected success". Logs: https://ci/internal/4190211111/output :eyes:
Samir Patel: I reproduced it twice on node-7, same assertion. Captured logs + core. Link: https://ci/internal/4190211111/run/2 :point_up:
ci-bot: Auto rerun queued (retry=1) — https://ci/internal/4190211111/rerun/1
Lee Huang: any correlation with yesterday's client timeout tweak? @Samir can you paste the failing stack snippet?
Samir Patel: here, trimming non-essential frames:
```
serve::retry::attempt(3) -> error: TimeoutError
runtime::timer::sleep at backoff.rs:48
assert!(result.is_ok(), "Retry attempt 3 exceeded, expected success")
```
Ana Torres: looks like a timing window in the retry loop — could be the test harness sleep resolution or a race with the mock backend. I'll try a deterministic-time patch to rule that out.
Maria Chen: for triage: if it's harness timing we can either patch the test or add a short flake guard in CI. Prefer a quick repro first. @Lee can you run with --force-seed and verbose?
Lee Huang: starting a run with `--force-seed=202403` + `--test-verbose` on node-12, will post results.
Samir Patel: flagged as flaky in CI (won't block master) and opened RINF-4823 to track root cause.
Maria Chen: good. Assigning: Ana -> deterministic-time patch & local repro; Lee -> reproducer + seeds; Samir -> logs/core analysis. I'll keep an eye on CI column and re-enable block if it becomes frequent. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Rerun completed (retry=1) — green on node-3, still red on node-7.
Lee Huang: repro failed with seed 202403 (green). Trying seed sweep next.
Ana Torres: posted a small patch that injects fake-clock into the test harness, submitting PR for quick experiment: https://git/repo/pull/7190 :hammer_and_wrench:
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. If the fake-clock reproduces consistently, we can roll a fix. Otherwise we'll bisect the recent infra changes next week. :calendar:
